description: Synthetic customer records for the agent demo. All names and figures are fictional, matching the case's own convention. Records contain ONLY observable raw data (CRM notes, behavioral flags, contact logs) -- no pre-assigned signal label. The DETECT step must classify each record live using knowledge_base/customer_signal_taxonomy.json. Design rationale and case-grounding for each record is documented separately in scenario_design_notes.md so it does not leak into the agent's input.
